summary: Specifies how to use SIP to establish an SRTP security context using DTLS. It describes carrying a fingerprint attribute in SDP to bind the signaling to the DTLS handshake used on the media path. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: To protect a call, each side shares a fingerprint of its ID ahead of time. Later, when the secure connection begins, they can check it matches and know they are talking to the right person.

questions: how does sip set up dtls-srtp
what is the sdp fingerprint attribute for dtls
